_README: Precedence:  environment variable  >  this file  >  built-in default.
The matching MTG_* env var always wins (tests and one-off scripts rely
on that). An empty string here means 'not set - use the default', not
'set to empty'. Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
Point elsewhere with MTG_CONFIG_FILE=/path/to/config.json. A missing or
malformed file is ignored and every value falls back to its default;
the server always starts. See mtg_analyzer/config.py for a full
description of every value and its env var / start.py flag.

paths._comment: cache_dir: disposable Scryfall cache, empty = backend/cache (MTG_CACHE_DIR). data_dir: persistent user data, empty = backend/data (MTG_DATA_DIR). bug_report_dir: local reports, empty = repo-root/bug-reports (MTG_BUG_REPORT_DIR).

accounts._comment: db_key_file: file holding the accounts.db key (64 hex chars, mode 600), must lie OUTSIDE data_dir; empty = ~/.decklab/accounts.key (MTG_ACCOUNTS_DB_KEY_FILE). backup_dir: encrypted accounts.db copies, empty = data_dir/backups (MTG_ACCOUNTS_BACKUP_DIR). The key itself is env-only (MTG_ACCOUNTS_DB_KEY), never stored here.

logging._comment: Level for the app's own mtg_analyzer.* loggers (and, via start.py, uvicorn's --log-level). CRITICAL/ERROR/WARNING/INFO/DEBUG; TRACE maps to DEBUG for the app. Env MTG_LOG_LEVEL / start.sh --log.

scryfall._comment: primary=false = cache-primary (never auto-refetch a cached card); true = refetch a stale row. Env MTG_SCRYFALL_PRIMARY / start.py --scryfall-primary.

multiplayer._comment: Seconds. idle_timeout: hold priority without acting before the socket is closed (0 disables). disconnect_grace: seat held open for a reconnect (0 = forever). spell_timer: per-priority auto-pass countdown shown on the board (0 disables); per-table overridable in Setup. mcp_seat_stale: MCP silence before Smart Bot fallback (0 prevents connection).

workers._comment: server_threads: how many games can be mid-step at once in this process (MTG_SERVER_THREAD_WORKERS / start.py --server-threads). dynamic_analysis_workers: how many analysis JOBS run concurrently, an admission cap (--analysis-jobs). dynamic_analysis_match_processes: worker PROCESSES one job spreads its matches across for real speed-up; 0 = one per CPU core, 1 = in-process (--analysis-match-workers).

limits._comment: Resource caps (BUG-43, PLR-18, ANA-6); every value shown is the built-in default, each has an MTG_* env var (see config.py). dynamic_analysis_queue_max: waiting analysis jobs before a new start is refused (503 analysis_queue_full). dynamic_analysis_queue_max_per_owner: queued + running jobs per account or anonymous visitor (429 analysis_owner_limit). dynamic_analysis_results_per_owner / _result_ttl_seconds: finished results kept per owner and for how long. session_*: game sessions (TTL, total); anon_session_*: sessions of visitors without a login. Sizes in bytes.

frontend._comment: origin: internal address the backend reverse-proxies non-/api//ws requests to (setup/start.py's static frontend server by default; a browser only ever needs to reach the backend port). Env MTG_FRONTEND_ORIGIN.
